from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def solve(n: int, o: QuantumCircuit) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)

    # start from uniform superposition
    for i in range(n):
        qc.h(i)

    # oracle
    qc.compose(o, inplace=True)

    # diffusion 2|s><s| - I
    for i in range(n):
        qc.h(i)
    for i in range(n):
        qc.x(i)

    # multi-controlled Z = H t, MCX, H t
    qc.h(n - 1)
    qc.mcx(list(range(n - 1)), n - 1)
    qc.h(n - 1)

    for i in range(n):
        qc.x(i)
    for i in range(n):
        qc.h(i)

    return qc

def solve(n: int, o: QuantumCircuit) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)

    # uniform superposition
    for i in range(n):
        qc.h(i)

    # phase oracle
    qc.compose(o, inplace=True)

    # partial diffusion on the first 3 qubits
    # H X ... X H  with CCZ = H CCX H
    k = 3
    for i in range(k):
        qc.h(i)
    for i in range(k):
        qc.x(i)

    # CCZ on qubits 0,1,2
    qc.h(2)
    qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)
    qc.h(2)

    for i in range(k):
        qc.x(i)
    for i in range(k):
        qc.h(i)

    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def solve(n: int, o: QuantumCircuit) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)

    # uniform superposition
    for i in range(n):
        qc.h(i)

    # phase oracle
    qc.compose(o, inplace=True)

    # diffusion on the two most significant qubits
    # 2|s><s| - I on qubits n-2, n-1
    q0 = n - 2
    q1 = n - 1
    for q in (q0, q1):
        qc.h(q)
        qc.x(q)
    qc.cz(q0, q1)
    for q in (q0, q1):
        qc.x(q)
        qc.h(q)

    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def solve(n: int, o: QuantumCircuit) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)

    # uniform superposition
    for i in range(n):
        qc.h(i)

    # phase oracle
    qc.compose(o, inplace=True)

    # 2-qubit diffusion on the first two qubits
    #  D = H X CZ X H  on qubits 0,1
    for i in (0, 1):
        qc.h(i)
        qc.x(i)
    qc.cp(3.141592653589793, 0, 1)   # CZ
    for i in (0, 1):
        qc.x(i)
        qc.h(i)

    return qc
